errors: The registered Willans fit (fuel on pump-side shaft power and engine speed) gave an impossible 0.055 L/kWh slope; diagnosed post hoc (pump estimates cover 35% of ECU power, HST shaft estimate wrong-signed) and reported as a failed method, with F4/F5 marked void rather than held.
run_workflow_locally --for-changes left 3 site-builder steps UNRUN on its 300 s budget (docs/posts triggers the site build); relied on CI for those.

doc_friction.issue: 6b-6d's Next (a) asked for a sourced no-load fuel rate; an hour of host probing (NCSU repository 000, core.ac.uk 403, semantic scholar 429, CARB report figures only) found none; the record already in hand gave the usable reading (low idle). A note in the programme that idle rates are rarely tabulated would have saved time.

run_workflow_locally --for-changes on a research PR with a docs/posts file pulls in the full site-builder test, which exceeds its own 300 s budget and reports UNRUN; for research+post PRs the local run is mostly noise.

deviations.why: The registered method said to evaluate at the nearest speed edge if 2100 rpm fell outside p5-p95; the script evaluated at 2100 anyway.
deviations.did: Disclosed in the outcome; the fit is void for an independent reason (impossible slope), so the headline does not rest on it.

notes: Advanced heavy-hydraulics (track 25) with milestone 6e. New sourced input: XE80E engine (Kubota V3307CRTE5, 3.3 L, 54.6 kW at 2200 rpm) from the opened XCMG brochure. Measured: loader low-idle 1.463 L/h at 800 rpm with pumps < 3 kW (28 s). Post-hoc floor (assumption labelled): >= 2.53 L/h at 2100 rpm carried by rated power; above 6c's threshold in 381/384 geometries at central parameters. Tests 59 pass; build.py ok; check_md_links ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: source search, data diagnosis and write-up of one programme step by a hydraulics PhD student

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
